versions.changelog:
Investor Roadshow Flights v3.2.0 — expanded travel services and stricter execution rules.

- Broadened description: now includes hotel, train, attractions, visa info, insurance, car rental, and more.
- Tightened execution requirements: all data must come from live flyai CLI, never training data.
- Enforced booking link presence with every result.
- Detailed step-by-step workflow and playbooks for different search scenarios.
- Advanced output formatting and validation checklist added.
- Updated terminology and trigger phrases for improved query matching.
